summary: Verified all 3 founder-reported bug fixes for MaterialMatch AI analyze flow: (1) pytest suite test_pin_and_vocab_fixes.py — 11/11 pass, covering SAM3 vocab additions (wainscot/trim/paneled wainscoting), per-label confidence overrides for architectural surfaces, group-based pin fallback, and bbox-derived scene pins.
